subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Giant pandas are the most endangered bears in the world.
• They live in six nature reserves in Sichuan Province, China.
• The province has a total of forty-seven nature reserves.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize how many nature reserves in Sichuan Province have giant pandas living in them. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Giant pandas, the world's most endangered bears, live in nature reserves in Sichuan Province, China.
choices.B: The most endangered bears in the world are found in Sichuan Province.
choices.C: Only six of the forty-seven nature reserves in Sichuan Province have giant pandas living in them.
choices.D: There are forty-seven nature reserves in China's Sichuan Province.

explanation:
Choice C is the best answer. The sentence emphasizes the number of nature reserves in Sichuan Province that have giant pandas living in them, noting that six of the province's forty-seven reserves have giant pandas.

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect. The sentence explains that Sichuan Province contains the world's most endangered bears; it doesn't identify these bears as giant pandas or emphasize how many of the province's reserves the bears live in.
